name: check-schedules-on-open
prompt:
Session started. Please do the following:
1. Use memory_context to load relevant background
2. CRITICAL: Use schedule_queue_pending to queue any due/overdue tasks to the execution queue
3. Use schedule_get_pending_executions to see waiting tasks
4. Use schedule_get_missed_executions to catch any overlooked tasks
5. For each pending execution:
   - Use schedule_claim_execution to claim it
   - EXECUTE the task description
   - Use schedule_complete_execution to mark it done
6. Briefly greet the user and summarize what was executed

Important: The execution queue ensures tasks are NEVER missed - even if you're late, queue_pending will catch overdue tasks. You are the executor - ACT on pending tasks immediately.
description: On workspace open: load context, queue pending tasks to execution queue, EXECUTE them, and greet user
